mustFix.problem: Fridge frame (and mop frame in the motion-on capture) renders as the striped fallback placeholder on desktop although the files decode and load at 390
mustFix.fix: Set loading="eager" on the three triptych images (or drop lazy), start the clip/opacity reveal only after img.decode() resolves, and with reduced motion show images at full opacity with no reveal; re-shoot and confirm all three frames in both 1440 full shots

elevate.move: Make the receipt the spine of the scroll instead of a column repeated in each band: one continuous paper strip down the left edge at >=1200px that prints each section's line as you pass, while content bands use the remaining width in different shapes (full-width services ledger, asymmetric quiz, area line), so the dead left columns in #services and #form disappear.

Art-direct the set as one home on one Friday: a sequence of the same kind of house (entry, kitchen counter, bathroom, stairs, living room) under one warm paper grade, each presented as a 'photo slip' stapled to its receipt line with a printed mono time stamp, so the photos read as proof-of-visit slips rather than stock.
